settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Shows Jellyfin on the main menu
Needs a Jellyfin server with Quick Connect on: its address in Server Address, then SIGN IN

settings.label: Sign In
settings.description:
Opens Jellyfin to sign in: the server's address, then Quick Connect
Signed in, the user in use

settings.label: Server Address
settings.description:
Your Jellyfin server, as http://192.168.1.10:8096
The sign-in screen fills it in too

settings.label: Libraries
settings.description: Which of the server's libraries the home screen lists

settings.label: Video Quality
settings.description:
The most a video is sent at
[DIRECT PLAY] The file as it is, no transcode
[1080P] [720P] Transcoded where larger
[576P] Transcoded where larger: a PAL CRT's lines
[480P] Transcoded where larger: an NTSC CRT's lines

settings.label: Resume Playback
settings.description:
Where a video stopped part-way starts again
[ASK] Asks: from where it stopped, or from the beginning
[ALWAYS] From where it stopped
[NEVER] From the beginning

settings.label: Autoplay Next Episode
settings.description:
What follows an episode played to its end
[ON] The next episode of the series
[OFF] Back to its page

settings.label: Intro Skip
settings.description:
What happens as a marked intro starts
[OFF] Nothing
[AUTO] Skipped by itself
[BUTTON] SKIP is offered: select skips
Needs the Intro Skipper plugin on the server

settings.label: Credit Skip
settings.description:
What happens as marked credits start
[OFF] Nothing
[AUTO] Skipped by itself
[BUTTON] SKIP is offered: select skips
Needs the Intro Skipper plugin on the server

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.description: Revokes this device's token on the server and forgets the sign-in here
